why: B is false (not_B, #rt_check OK), as the blind formalizer flagged: B is stated for all n, and for n = 1 the hypothesis K(U,U) ≥ (n−1)/r² = 0 holds on the flat line ℝ¹ (open slice submanifold univ ⊆ ℝ¹ via RoundTrip.Bridge, induced metric, Levi-Civita connection Bridge.conn; blind curvR and ricci vanish there via Bridge.isCurvVal_iff and Morse.curvR_eq_zero_of_top), which has geodesics of every length (segments), but E_** is positive semi-definite on a flat manifold: a blind IsHessT value h with W₁ = W₂ = X is the project's energyHessian of a field agreeing with X on [0,1] (Emb.isHessT_eq, copied from Items/V11_8.lean, through RoundTrip/EnergyC2.lean), and Morse.energyHessian_pos_of_nonpos makes it ≥ 0, so no X_i with E_**(X_i,X_i) < 0 exists (k = 1, r = 1, length 10 > π). A holds, so ¬(A → B); B → A is ex falso. A itself is correct (its exists_sinBump_neg assumes 2 ≤ dim, as Milnor's argument needs) and, on embedded manifolds, implies the repaired B (n ≥ 2): A_to_B_emb2. A is more specific than Milnor's sentence (explicit sin-bump fields, an integral formula for their E_**, frame-sum hypothesis instead of the Ricci bound), and those parts are not consequences of B.
B_issue: False for n = 1 (and B quantifies over all n): with K ≥ (n−1)/r² = 0 a flat circle or line has geodesics of arbitrary length but E_** ≥ 0. Milnor's proof of 19.6 presupposes n ≥ 2 (19.4 does too). Formalized literally on purpose (the blind docstring flags it). Fix: assume 2 ≤ n.
overlap: A'_to_B_emb2: 242 shared project theorems — sinBump_of_le/ge, parallel-field basics (IsParallel.*), the second-variation integral machinery (energyHessian_apply, secondVariation_eq_hessForm, covD_*, PieceData.*, integral_eq_of_piecewise) and curvature basics (curvR_of_mem, curvOp_*), entering through the Hessian dictionary; A's four theorems are used only as the hypothesis. not_B: 219 shared theorems (energyHessian_eq_integral, secondVariation/covD/PieceData, curvature basics, via energyHessian_pos_of_nonpos and the Hessian dictionary); none of the sinBump lemmas.

Hence: not_B is checked (OK); B_to_A := (not_B hB).elim is not checked; for the embedded case A' := A's conjuncts 1, 3, 4 with the membership proofs generalized to hypotheses, A_to_A' (proof irrelevance, unchecked), and A'_to_B_emb2 is checked (OK).
embedded_special_case_note: Items/V11_15.lean: B_emb := B for M = Bridge.Sub hN (↥N, model ℝⁿ, induced metric, connected), cov = Bridge.conn (B_to_B_emb via conn_isLC). B_emb is false too (the flat-line counter-model is embedded), so A ⇒ B_emb is false. Repaired B_emb2 := B_emb with 2 ≤ n (B_emb_to_B_emb2). Proved: A_to_B_emb2 (via A'_to_B_emb2, #rt_check OK): the blind Ricci bound gives Morse.RicciLowerBound (Emb.ricci_eq of Items/V11_24.lean, Bridge.norm_eq); Morse.exists_parallel_frame (project lemma, not in A) gives the frame; A's exists_sinBump_neg picks on each piece [i/k,(i+1)/k] a frame field with E_**(X_i,X_i) < 0; A's energyHessian_sinBump_disjoint (+ Morse.energyHessian_isSymm) gives E_**(X_i,X_j) = 0; fields carried to blind TΩ by Emb.toW / toW_mem and values to blind IsHessT by the converse Hessian dictionary (Emb.exists_isHessT + isHessT_eq, new wrapper Emb.isHessT_toW); vanishing off (i/k,(i+1)/k) by Morse.sinBump_of_le/ge. Not done: B_emb2 ⇒ A — A's integral formula and the explicit sin-bump fields with frame hypotheses are not consequences of B's existence statement (genuine).
